items.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could let stablecoin partners print new tokens
items.summary: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

items.title: Bitcoin's 'volatility curve' has a midterm bump
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 2, 2026

items.title: No proof of AI in North Korean hackers move of stolen Binance funds
items.summary: Elliptic tracked thousands of transfers, failed swaps and repeated transactions that suggest the hackers relied on scripts rather than AI agents.

items.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.

items.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
items.summary: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

items.title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
items.summary: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 2.

items.title: Live updates: Binance records $6 billion outflows after starting withdrawals, less then 4% of total holdings
items.summary: The outflows followed a 45-hour withdrawal freeze after a $6.3 billion theft, with rival exchanges attracting deposits as customers regained access to their funds.

items.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
items.summary: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.

items.title: Why stealing billions from a crypto exchange can be harder to stop than a bank theft
items.summary: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
items.summary: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw  the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

items.title: Binance taps half its SAFU Bitcoin holdings, releases reserve proof
items.summary: Binance’s SAFU Bitcoin wallet now holds about 7,500 BTC after a 7,499 BTC transfer linked to the hack, with no timeline for restoring the $1 billion fund.

items.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
items.summary: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.

items.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
items.summary: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.

items.title: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?
items.summary: Bitcoin lost 7.3% in October 2026 after another decline the previous year, despite the month’s historically strong returns, as analysts reassess seasonal signals.

items.title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
items.summary: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.

items.title: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
items.summary: The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.

items.title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.summary: Bitcoin price action held its 100-day moving average into the monthly close as crypto markets braced for US midterm election and tech earnings volatility.

items.title: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B
items.summary: OKX led cryptocurrency exchanges with $445 million in daily inflows, while Binance processed about $7 billion in net outflows.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.

items.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
items.summary: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

items.title: Morning Minute: The Binance Hack Leads to Mass Outflows while FBI Opens Probe
items.summary: Uptober was far from it, with the Binance hack punctuating a red month. Will November be better? Or will the Binance hack hang over crypto?

items.title: Strategy Resumes Bitcoin Buys With $66M Purchase
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm also spent $208.2 million buying back its STRC preferred stock, cutting its USD Cash balance to $132.7 million.

items.title: BTCPay Tells Merchants to Switch Off Servers Amid Hot Wallet Attack Reports
items.summary: The Bitcoin payment software says attacks targeted versions 2.4.1 and older, days after it shipped an emergency fix for a critical flaw.

items.title: FBI Blames North Korea for $6B Binance Hack as Exchange Reopens Withdrawals
items.summary: Binance saw $3.64 billion in net outflows in the first nine and a half hours after reopening withdrawals, or 2.1% of its assets, it said.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

items.title: How to Run an AI Model Locally—And Why You Might Want To
items.summary: Free tools like Ollama and LM Studio can run open-weight AI models on your laptop, offline, and without a subscription. Here's how to get started.

items.title: Binance Hack: Everything You Need to Know About the Biggest Crypto Heist in History
items.summary: Attackers tied to North Korea drained roughly $6.4 billion from the world’s largest crypto exchange. Here’s what we know about how it happened, who’s behind it, and what comes next.

items.title: Why AI Models Cheat: Reward Hacking, Explained
items.summary: From boat-racing bots to OpenAI models inside Hugging Face, here's how AI reward hacking works and why it matters.

items.title: Binance Hack Shows Why Offshore Exchanges Need US Oversight, CFTC Chair Says
items.summary: Michael Selig said the record $6.4 billion theft shows why offshore exchanges should register with the CFTC and adopt U.S.-grade cybersecurity standards.

items.title: Intel Stock Suffers Worst Crash in 50 Years as Weak Forecast Overshadows AI Chip Demand
items.summary: Intel beat third-quarter earnings expectations, but warned of a prolonged PC slump, sending shares to their worst daily decline in 50 years.
